Uphill Delivery

Uphill Delivery is a physics-based platformer set high above the clouds. Navigate a clumsy, unstable active ragdoll across floating islands to deliver packages. Every step is a test of patience and physical coordination.

Slip Past

You move by sliding. Pick a direction and you keep gliding until a wall, a locked gate, or something worse stops you. Dodge guards with cones of vision, grab keys for gates, and avoid spikes and electric traps.
